PHONE: none stored and the county page gives none. A search snippet attributes (701) 636-4458 to the ndtourism.com listing, which I could not read; Google Maps lists no phone. Left for a human.

BOOKING: no current online booking found; the county describes honor-system donation camping. A directory (The Dyrt, unread directly) is reported as saying the park 'has been closed on and off during the time of the pandemic'; nothing official shows a current closure.

WATERFRONT (no change): the park fills a meander of the Red River (channel ~50 m wide on imagery, so riverfront-sized), but the camping area is under continuous canopy with a tree band along the bank; no site numbers or pads could be placed, so not waterfront stands.

FIT: wooded gravel loop roads are visible; pads under canopy could not be measured. The county calls it 'primitive camping' with limited electric; 23-ft fit unconfirmed by any operator source (no length stated).
